name: JG_DOCUMENT_ACTIONS_INT
description: This interface table contains document action events to be processed on fiscal documents.

columns.name: DOC_INTERFACE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Interface identifier of the document action.

columns.name: DOC_INTERFACE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Document action line number identifier for each document action interface record.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: To identify the name of the batch containing the document action interface records.

columns.name: UPLOAD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the source of the data upload.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_KEY
columns.description: Fiscal document access key composed by concatenation of fiscal document number and other fiscal document information. It is used as unique identifier for the tax authority system.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Fiscal document action code representing the action to be performed in a document. Possible values are Cancellation, Void and Contingency.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Receivables or Shipping.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction, which indicates the type of transaction being created.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction, such as requisition, purchase order and agreement, and release.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier of receivables, tax or shipping transaction.

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: System-generated identification number of a transaction.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_NUM
columns.description: Unique number that is assigned to a document, such as fiscal document number or tax invoice number.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: BU_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_TYPE
columns.description: Fiscal document contingency type with valid values, such as Security form, Contingency system of national environment, and Declaration of issuance provided in the contingency.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_DOC_SERIES_ID
columns.description: Fiscal document series for contingency fiscal documents.

columns.name: ACTION_REASON
columns.description: Reason provided by the user for setting the transaction status.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROCESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request ID that processed the record.

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the final status of record after processing.
